the social audience does not always coincide with the real audience and that the success of a program depends on its format and not on the genre of television.
the most popular television programs are not necessarily the most popular on social networks, and vice versa.

the analysis and comparison of the real audience and social audience of prime-time television in the months of May and April 2013.
